title: AI Agent Skill Lint Rules
description: Machine-readable catalog of lint rules for Claude Code agent-skill definitions (~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and ~/.claude/agents/*.md, under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when set). The fourth ctxlint pillar. v1 is intentionally Claude-Code-only; other agents' skill/subagent formats may be added in later spec versions.

categories.name: Agent Skill Audit
categories.description: Validates Claude Code skill (SKILL.md) and agent (.md) definition files for frontmatter presence, broken references, trigger collisions, orphaned skills, and dead tool restrictions.

severityVariants.when: a skill or agent opens frontmatter with --- but never closes it
severityVariants.message: {file}: frontmatter opens with `---` but is never closed

severityVariants.when: an agent file has no frontmatter
an agent frontmatter lacks a required field (name, description)
a SKILL.md has no frontmatter (Claude Code then uses the first non-empty body line as the description)
a SKILL.md frontmatter has no description

rules.description: A SKILL.md or agent .md file is missing YAML frontmatter, or a field within it. Agents require `name` + `description` (the description decides when Claude Code delegates to the agent). A skill requires no field; without a description Claude Code falls back to the first non-empty body line, which rarely says when to use the skill.
rules.trigger: The file has unclosed frontmatter (error), an agent has no frontmatter (error) or lacks name/description (warning), or a skill has no frontmatter or no description (info).

rules.description: A relative path reference (./ or ../) in a SKILL.md / agent body does not resolve to a file or directory relative to the skill/agent file. Reuses the path-reference detection shape from the context-file pillar; only explicitly-relative refs are verified to avoid false positives on prose.
rules.trigger: A ./ or ../ path token in the body does not exist on disk relative to the skill directory. Tokens in unlabeled fences and in code, shell or data fences (js, ts, py, bash, console, json, yaml, ...; ``` or ~~~ of any length), in HTML-comment lines and in inline-code command spans are not resolved. After an invocation verb (run, start, call, launch, ...) only executable-shaped spans are skipped; .md, .json, .txt and trailing-/ references there are still checked.
rules.message: {file}: references "{path}" which does not exist relative to the skill directory

rules.description: Two or more skills/agents declare the same trigger phrase (a quoted phrase in the description, or a trigger/triggers field). When triggers collide, only one wins -- invocation becomes non-deterministic.
rules.trigger: A normalized trigger phrase (lowercased, whitespace-collapsed) is declared by more than one distinct skill/agent file. Quoted phrases governed by a negation (Not for "x", "y" or "z") are not triggers.
rules.message: Trigger phrase "{trigger}" is declared by {count} skills/agents — only one will win

rules.description: A ~/.claude/skills/<name>/ directory exists but contains no SKILL.md. Claude Code has nothing to load for that skill -- the directory is dead weight.
rules.trigger: A subdirectory of ~/.claude/skills/ does not contain a SKILL.md file.
rules.message: {dir}: skill directory has no SKILL.md — Claude Code has nothing to load

severityVariants.when: the unknown name is not PascalCase (lowercase, separators): far more likely a typo
the unknown name is PascalCase: it may be a built-in newer than the linter's known-tool list

rules.description: A tool restriction (agent tools / disallowedTools, skill allowed-tools / disallowed-tools) lists a tool name that is not a known Claude Code built-in tool. A dead restriction silently fails to grant/deny the intended tool. MCP-namespaced tools (mcp__server__tool) and wildcards are not validated (their existence depends on loaded MCP servers). The suggestion names the case-correct tool when only the case differs, else points to code.claude.com/docs/en/tools-reference.
rules.trigger: A non-MCP, non-wildcard entry (a permission specifier like Bash(git add *) is reduced to its tool name) in an agent's tools/disallowedTools (comma-separated) or a skill's allowed-tools/disallowed-tools (space- or comma-separated) does not match a known built-in Claude Code tool name (Bash, Read, Edit, Glob, Grep, Write, Agent, WebFetch, WebSearch, etc.; list refreshed 2026-11-22).
rules.message: {file}: tool restriction lists "{tool}" which is not a known Claude Code tool

dataSources.name: Claude Code
dataSources.notes: Read from CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR instead of ~/.claude when it is set; findings then show that directory.
